independence: Independent auditor: agent role i18n-auditor, a different agent from the translator (i18n-translator, per the translation records read here). None of the 31 audited strings was authored by this run. Five of them were FIXED by this run after the audit recorded them, at the operator's direction: es ui.ownerAudit.read_only (plural agreement), hi ui.ownerAudit.viewers_label and ui.ownerAudit.disclosure (label form and legal register), vi and zh-CN ui.teamBridge.thread.not_available (open vs access). findings.current: A los demás miembros se les indica que los propietarios de agentes pueden auditar la conversación.
findings.proposed: A los demás miembros se les dice que …
findings.reason: 'Indicar' leans administrative where the sidecar asks for plain, no legal register; 'decir' is plainer. Both required facts are stated correctly and nothing is weakened, so this is a register preference recorded rather than churned.

findings.current: … porque eres propietario del jefe de gabinete al que cubre.
findings.proposed: … porque tienes la propiedad del jefe de gabinete al que cubre.
findings.reason: 'Eres propietario' addresses the reader with a masculine-gendered noun. It matches this locale's established convention (ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role.body, ui.hub.teams.org.no_access_body), so it is a convention and not a defect; a neutral possessive would remove the gender if the locale ever moves.

Renders 'readable' with 'visible'. Acceptable for a label over a list of names (carries 'también', no colon, no placeholder, three words) and it reuses the wording of the round-1 sentence this key replaces; 'legible' would track the English noun more closely at a small cost in naturalness.

resolved_findings.reason: Number agreement: a coordinated subject of three infinitives takes the plural copula.
